name: view_duel_resync_rekeys_salts
description: A world loaded under the same match may number my bottles otherwise than the one this client ran (a RESYNC(desync): a build that stood here and was refused there shifts next_id), so on attach each salt goes to the bottle whose commitment it opens, never to the id it had (Game._rekey_corks, by window and SimUndertow.commit). On Undertow's own rules against the caretaker, in window 2, as a resync does (a checkpoint loaded as the scene's world, the views rebuilt): first a checkpoint from before my cork whose ids run one ahead, so my salt has no bottle there and waits for its CORK again, and the turns run again stand it under another id, where it takes its salt by its seq; then a checkpoint of the match with my bottle numbered otherwise, where the salt goes to the bottle it opens, and the old id holds nothing. My bottle shows its pack and salt throughout (never 'lost'), and in wave 2 the client uncorks it itself at 24 s with that salt: it opens, nothing refused, nothing fizzled.

steps.msg: my bottle stands with its salt

steps.assert: Game.sim == scene.sim and Game.bottles_of(1).is_empty() and Game._corks.is_empty() and Game._corks_waiting.size() == 1 and Game._corks_waiting[0]['unsure'] and Game._corks_waiting[0]['pack'] == pack
steps.msg: a world from before the cork: no bottle opens with my salt there, so it waits for its CORK again

steps.assert: second == first + 1 and Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == pack and Game._corks.has(second) and Game._corks_waiting.is_empty()
steps.msg: the turns run again stand it under another id, and it takes its salt by its seq
the next world loaded numbers my bottle otherwise

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['id'] == now and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == pack and Game._corks.has(now) and not Game._corks.has(second)
steps.msg: its salt went to the bottle it opens, not to the id it had

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked'] and Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['pack'] == pack and not Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['fizzled'] and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 7).size() == 1
steps.msg: at 24 s the client uncorked it with its salt, once, and it opened
